summary.name: OmniDiskSweeper
summary.one_liner: OmniDiskSweeper is a Mac utility that lists files on a drive from largest to smallest so you can quickly trash or open the big ones.
use_cases: Finding large files taking up space on a Mac
Sweeping unwanted big files into the Trash
Freeing up disk space on a Mac
Reviewing which files are largest on a drive
summary.what_it_does: The page describes OmniDiskSweeper as showing files on a drive sorted from largest to smallest. Users can quickly Trash or open the listed files. A third-party list (awesome-mac, under Cleanup and Uninstall) describes it as scanning files by size and marks it as freeware. The page also covers two legacy Omni products: OmniWeb, a browser no longer actively maintained, and OmniPresence, a legacy document-syncing service for iOS and macOS.
notable: Lists files largest to smallest so space hogs are easy to spot
Can Trash or open files directly from the list
caveats: OmniWeb is no longer actively maintained; OmniWeb 5 supports Mac OS X 10.4.8 to 10.11, and OmniWeb 6 is only test builds for macOS 10.12 and later
OmniPresence is described as a legacy solution
